spec.name: sprint42_taker_imbalance_24h_majors
spec.hypothesis: Extreme z-scored taker-buy imbalance (smooth 60m, z>2.5 vs 1440m) predicts multi-day-lag continuation (EFMA 2025). All prior taker_imbalance specs held <=15m where T2 costs (~26bp) swamp the ~33bp bar dispersion; a 24h hold amortizes cost ~100x. New mechanism: horizon, not a retread of sprint05-23.
spec.power_argument: 24h return std ~300bp on majors (estimate). n=300 gives SE ~17bp, so min detectable edge at t=2 is ~35bp, above the ~26bp T2 cost floor. 8 symbols x cap 2/day x ~92 validation days allows up to 1472 entries; z>2.5 frequency should realize 300-700. Overlapping holds across correlated majors reduce effective n; the spec must be read with that. If realized n<300 the validator rejects it.
